title: Side drawer (menu)
one_line: What the top-bar burger opens: mascot hero and every destination as a row.

anatomy.spec: ground.scrim over the rest of the screen.
Drawer NX Card variant (bible 5.4, 5.24): full height, flush to the right edge, mascot hero image at the top.
Emblem icon + label rows: SHOP, PROFILE, FRIENDS, MISSIONS, RANKINGS, INBOX, SETTINGS, SUPPORT, LEGAL.
Close X at the bottom centre.

states: Notification dots on Inbox/Missions when something is unclaimed
motion: Slide in from the right, 220 ms ease-out. Slide out 160 ms ease-in.
data: Row destinations are static; badge counts come from the relevant service (DailyMissionsData, inbox unread count).

assets_needed.name: Drawer mascot hero
assets_needed.prompt: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 6, P0-4: the source file of the existing drawer mascot hero (Group 115/91 top image) at full resolution.

do_not: Do not put more rows than the destinations listed - do not invent new destinations without the owner.
Do not skip the close X - a drawer still needs an explicit close.
acceptance: Opens from the burger on every hub.
Notification dots reflect real unclaimed state.
steps: 1. Preflight - chase the P0-4 mascot asset from the owner.
2. Build the drawer chassis with the mascot hero and identity block.
3. Build the nine rows with emblem icons and wire navigation.
5. Capture open and closed transitions. Postflight.
